name: nfl-combine-40-timeseries
title: NFL Combine 40-Yard Dash Movement Time Series (2026)
description: Per-frame position, velocity, acceleration and pose time series of 40-yard dashes measured from the 2026 NFL Combine broadcasts, labelled SKILL, STRONG or LINEMAN. See README.md and DATASHEET.md.

sources.title: NFL YouTube channel, 2026 NFL Combine 40-yard dash videos (see data/videos.csv)

resources.name: runs
resources.description: one row per detected run: identity, class, split, clock times, QC

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: run identifier, <video_id>_<nnn> in clock-start order within the video

fields.name: video_id
fields.description: YouTube video id (see videos.csv)

fields.name: group
fields.description: session name from the video title

fields.name: position
fields.description: session position (WR, CB, SAF, RB, TE, LB, EDGE, OL, DT)

fields.name: panel_pos
fields.description: position code read from the broadcast panel (WR, DB, RB, TE, LB, DL, OL, QB)

fields.name: cls
fields.description: class label: SKILL, STRONG or LINEMAN

fields.name: athlete
fields.description: athlete key <panel_pos>-<bib>; bibs are unique within a position group

fields.name: bib
fields.description: bib number read from the broadcast panel (majority vote over the run)

fields.name: attempt
fields.description: attempt number of this athlete (1 or 2)

fields.name: split
fields.description: train or test; by athlete, stratified by position within class, seed 2026

fields.name: status
fields.description: ok, rejected (failed QC), excluded (not a class position) or duplicate

fields.name: qc_reason
fields.description: QC rules that failed, name=value, separated by ';'

fields.name: time_40yd
fields.description: unofficial 40-yd time: the on-screen clock value when it stops

fields.name: time_10yd
fields.description: unofficial 10-yd split shown on the panel (line groups only)

fields.name: t_at_10yd
fields.description: clock time when the measured hip crosses 10 yd

fields.name: clip_ss
fields.description: video time of the first decoded frame of the run's clip

fields.name: clip_frames
fields.description: number of decoded frames in the clip

fields.name: k0
fields.description: clip frame (fractional) where the clock reads 0

fields.name: clock_resid_p95
fields.description: 95th percentile |read - fit| of the clock over the run

fields.name: clock_coverage
fields.description: share of run frames with a clock read

fields.name: bib_agree
fields.description: share of bib reads agreeing with the majority

fields.name: panel_min_corr
fields.description: lowest panel-logo correlation with the video's reference

fields.name: max_cut
fields.description: largest frame-to-frame colour histogram change (Bhattacharyya)

fields.name: turf_min
fields.description: lowest share of turf-green pixels in a frame

fields.name: turf_median
fields.description: median share of turf-green pixels

fields.name: lane_frac
fields.description: share of run frames with a lane measurement

fields.name: track_frac
fields.description: share of run frames with the runner's position

fields.name: start_support
fields.description: frames supporting the start-line detection

fields.name: x_at_zero
fields.description: hip position at the clock start

fields.name: x_at_stop
fields.description: hip position at the clock stop

fields.name: max_step_yd
fields.description: largest frame-to-frame position change

fields.name: yardline_resid
fields.description: median distance of the painted yard lines from the 5-yd marks of our scale

resources.name: series
resources.description: per-frame series of every kept run (primary product)

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: run identifier, <video_id>_<nnn> in clock-start order within the video

fields.name: frame
fields.description: frame index within the decoded clip of the run

fields.name: t_clock
fields.description: time on the broadcast 40-yd clock at this frame (fitted, sub-frame zero)

fields.name: x_yd
fields.description: position along the lane of the ground point under the hip centre, from the start line

fields.name: v_yds
fields.description: velocity: Savitzky-Golay derivative of x_yd (15 frames)

fields.name: a_yds2
fields.description: acceleration: Savitzky-Golay second derivative of x_yd (21 frames)

fields.name: trunk_angle
fields.description: shoulder-mid to hip-mid vs image vertical, positive leaning forward

fields.name: hip_height_ratio
fields.description: hip height above the ground point under it / run-median leg length

fields.name: knee_lead
fields.description: knee angle of the leg further along the lane (180 = straight)

fields.name: knee_trail
fields.description: knee angle of the rear leg (180 = straight)

fields.name: hip_flex_lead
fields.description: trunk-thigh angle of the forward leg

fields.name: hip_flex_trail
fields.description: trunk-thigh angle of the rear leg

fields.name: shin_angle_lead
fields.description: forward leg's shin vs image vertical, positive leaning forward

fields.name: thigh_sep
fields.description: angle between the two thighs

fields.name: elbow_angle
fields.description: mean of both elbow angles

fields.name: arm_swing
fields.description: fore-aft spread of the two wrists / arm length

fields.name: foot_contact
fields.description: 1 while a foot is planted (ankle stationary along the lane)

fields.name: step_freq_hz
fields.description: 1 / time between successive touchdowns, held until the next; empty before the first stride

fields.name: step_len_yd
fields.description: distance between successive touchdowns, held until the next; empty before the first stride

fields.name: valid
fields.description: 1 where position and the core pose channels are all measured
